title: SkillForgeBench: Evaluating Agent Reliability Grounded in Agent Skill Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2610.14918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating an agent's ability to strictly satisfy diverse and procedurally complex requirements is essential to determining its practical reliability. Conducting such an evaluation demands agentic tasks that reconcile broad domain coverage with deep procedural complexity. Existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: expert-curated benchmarks achieve procedural depth but suffer from domain diversity bottlenecks, whereas crowdsourced benchmarks span diverse scenarios but lack execution rigor. translated_title: SkillForgeBench：基于智能体技能规范的智能体可靠性评估
translated_abstract: 评估智能体严格满足多样化且程序复杂需求的能力，对于确定其实际可靠性至关重要。开展此类评估需要能够兼顾广泛领域覆盖与深层程序复杂性的智能体任务。现有范式面临根本性的权衡：专家策划的基准虽然实现了程序深度，却受制于领域多样性的瓶颈；而众包基准虽然覆盖了多样化场景，却缺乏执行的严谨性。为化解这一矛盾，我们提出了SkillForgeBench，它将智能体技能作为统一的执行蓝图，贯穿三个协同设计的阶段：（1）资源准备阶段利用领域均衡的技能来指导工件检索，建立广泛的工作流覆盖；（2）技能驱动的任务合成阶段将技能作为程序锚点，用以划分工件角色、合成自然的任务指令，并打包沙盒化场景以实现深层程序复杂性……
tldr: SkillForgeBench以智能体技能作为统一执行蓝图，通过资源准备、技能驱动任务合成等三个协同设计阶段，构建了兼顾领域多样性与程序复杂性的智能体可靠性评估基准，化解了专家策划基准与众包基准之间的根本性权衡。
en_tdlr: SkillForgeBench leverages agent skills as unified execution blueprints across three co-designed stages to build an agent reliability benchmark that reconciles broad domain diversity with deep procedural complexity, resolving the fundamental trade-off between expert-curated and crowdsourced benchmarks.
